descriptionHtml:
Onikuma CW935 Triple-Mode Ergonomic Wireless RGB Black Gaming Mouse with Hidden Receiver Compartment

Master your gameplay comfort and unlock advanced tracking versatility with the Onikuma CW935 Triple-Mode Ergonomic Wireless RGB Black Gaming Mouse. Available at Turbo Computer, this professional PC hardware gaming peripheral is engineered for competitive esports players, laptop power users, and digital workspace managers across Egypt who demand zero layout restrictions, immediate click response, and fatigue-free tracking control. Designed with a premium contoured ergonomic outer shell to naturally support your palm during extended productivity hours, this mouse is backed by an official 1-year warranty for complete peace of mind.

The Onikuma CW935 delivers ultimate desktop adaptability through its Tri-mode connectivity matrix, allowing you to cycle instantly between lag-free 1000Hz ultra-speed 2.4GHz wireless tracking, multi-profile Bluetooth channels, and a secure wired USB-C mode that safely recharges the internal 500mAh battery. Powered by a high-precision Instant S203 optical sensor and a Furrion FR2012A chip framework, it processes 6-stage adjustable dynamic tracking paths scaling up to 12,800 DPI with 100 IPS velocity. Complete with vibrant multi-zone RGB backlight illumination, 6 programmable action buttons rated for 20 million clicks, and a built-in hidden storage slot for the USB dongle, this matte black mouse is the perfect hardware companion for travel and desk setups.
